admin.title: Admin
admin.invite.attachment: Attachment (a PDF document from the archive)
admin.accounts.grant_confirm: Give {who} admin rights? An admin can invite people, edit and delete them, and disable accounts.
admin.accounts.unlink_confirm: Unlink this account from {who}? The person stays in the tree, only the account stops pointing at them.
admin.accounts.signout_confirm: Sign {who} out on every device? They will have to log in again with a code from e-mail.
admin.accounts.protect_confirm: Protect {who}? Only the founder will be able to take their admin rights away or disable the account.
admin.accounts.unprotect_confirm: Remove protection from {who}? Other admins will be able to take their admin rights away and disable the account.
admin.accounts.link_help: Linking ties an account to a person in the tree: it shows who is who, makes birthday and anniversary reminders work, and lets that person add their own photos and documents.
admin.backup.title: Backup
admin.backup.what: One ZIP: the whole database as an SQL file, every photo and document, and the restore instructions. Keep it off Cloudflare — on a disk, in a cloud, anywhere.
admin.backup.failed: The last attempt to download a backup did not finish ({when}). The file saved then is incomplete — download it again.
admin.backup.never: No backup has been downloaded yet.
ops.warning.domain_soon: The domain {domain} expires {when} — renew it with the registrar.
ops.warning.domain_unknown: The site does not know when the domain {domain} has to be renewed — look the date up at the registrar and put it in the settings (DOMAIN_RENEWS_AT in wrangler.toml).
ops.warning.card_soon: The card on file at Cloudflare expires {when}. Replace it — otherwise the next payment will fail.
ops.warning.backup_stale: The last backup is over 60 days old — download a fresh one.
ops.warning.backup_never: No backup has ever been downloaded.
ops.warning.check_failing: The billing check has been failing for over a week — the token may have been revoked.
ops.warning.backup_failed: The last backup download did not finish — the file saved then is incomplete. Download the backup again.
ops.warning.checks_never: The site has not checked itself yet — the daily check runs overnight. If this note is still here tomorrow, the check is not running.
ops.warning.checks_stale: The site has not checked itself for over three days — the daily check has stopped running, so this information may be out of date.
ops.warning.checks_unreadable: The site's own status could not be read, so I cannot tell you what is paid up and what is not. Try refreshing; if it persists, check the Cloudflare dashboard and the domain registrar.
stepup.needed: This action needs a passkey confirmation.
error.step_up_required: Confirm with your passkey to do this.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.expired: The code expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
error.passkey_required: This account has no passkey — it cannot be an admin.
error.last_passkey: An admin must keep at least one passkey.
error.conflict: This already exists, or cannot be done to your own account.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
